notes.title: Trial Version 1.0.2.2 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]Fix the issue of ineffective mouse speed settings[/p][p]Cancelled the mouse speed delay setting (now the mouse speed is faster and can be modified in the settings)[/p][p]Add Shrine Function[/p][p]Add random rewards in the corner[/p]

notes.title: Demo version update 1.0.1.5
notes.content: [p]1. Optimized most of the lagging issues.[/p][p]2. New melee characters have been updated as trial content.[/p][p]3. Added new map levels as trial content.[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue of some props not working correctly.[/p][p]5. Adjusted the numerical strength of some props.[/p]

notes.title: Version update 1.0.0.6
notes.content: [p][b]Thank you for trying the \[Fracturefront Demo]  ! After release, we identified several issues and received great suggestions from players. The following updates have been implemented:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed incorrect equipment descriptions or malfunctioning equipment effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted combat maps and scene layouts to provide a wider field of view during battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved UI interaction issues and optimized interface content.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed achievement unlocking failures.[/p][/*][*][p]Repaired malfunctioning character skills.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you encounter any problems or need feedback, please contact [url="https://discord.com/invite/ASWWxTHE"]https://discord.com/invite/ASWWxTHE[/url][/p]
